name: hollowbrook
description: Hollowbrook — a first-person siege in a walled fantasy town (scene pipeline + CharForge + SoundForge)

scripts.check:siege-game: node scripts/check-contract-drift.mjs && node scripts/check-feel.mjs && node scripts/check-feel-ladder.mjs && node scripts/check-reproducibility.mjs && node scripts/simulate-siege.mjs && node scripts/check-music-state.mjs && node scripts/check-npc-soak.mjs && node scripts/check-shell-persistence.mjs && node scripts/check-play.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-city-plan.mjs && node scripts/check-terrain.mjs && node scripts/check-nav.mjs && node scripts/check-city.mjs
scripts.gates: for s in validate-city-plan check-terrain check-nav check-city check-cameras check-spatial check-game check-interactions check-arena-visibility check-feel check-feel-ladder check-contract-drift check-reproducibility simulate-siege check-music check-music-state check-npc-soak check-shell-persistence check-play; do echo "== $s"; node scripts/$s.mjs > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo PASS || echo FAIL; done
